# signing

```go
import "github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/pkg/signing"
```

Package signing provides cosign\-compatible signing and verification for cargoship packages, against an ordinary cosign keypair.

Originally a fork of zarf's src/pkg/signing, which wrapped cosign's CLI command structs. Those are gone: the command structs carried Fulcio, OIDC, cloud KMS, transparency\-log and policy\-evaluation machinery that cannot be reached from the air\-gapped management node cargoship runs on, and that linked Open Policy Agent, cuelang, go\-github and the GitLab client into the binary. Signing and verification now go through sigstore\-go in signkey.go and verifykey.go.

A cosign keypair is the only supported signing method. Keyless \(Fulcio/OIDC\) signing and verification were removed; see docs/agent/choice\-signing\-fork.md and https://github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/issues/848.

<a name="SignBlobWithKey"></a>
## func [SignBlobWithKey](<https://github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/blob/main/pkg/signing/signkey.go#L115>)

```go
func SignBlobWithKey(ctx context.Context, keyPath, password, blobPath, bundlePath string) error
```

SignBlobWithKey signs blobPath with a cosign\-format private key and writes a Sigstore bundle to bundlePath, using sigstore\-go rather than cosign's CLI.

No transparency log, no timestamp authority and no Fulcio certificate: the bundle carries the public key and the signature, which is all an air\-gapped verifier has to work with. Nothing here reaches the network.

<a name="VerifyBlobWithKey"></a>
## func [VerifyBlobWithKey](<https://github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/blob/main/pkg/signing/verifykey.go#L40>)

```go
func VerifyBlobWithKey(publicKeyPath, bundlePath, blobPath string) (err error)
```

VerifyBlobWithKey verifies a Sigstore bundle over blobPath against a PEM\-encoded public key, using sigstore\-go rather than cosign's CLI command structs.

This is the air\-gapped case and only that case: a key the operator holds, a bundle beside the artifact, no Fulcio certificate, no transparency log lookup and no timestamp authority. Nothing here reaches the network.

It is deliberately not a replacement for CosignVerifyBlobWithOptions, which still covers the certificate and keyless paths. See docs/agent/choice\-signing\-fork.md.

## type [BundleInfo](<https://github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/blob/main/pkg/signing/bundle.go#L41-L46>)

BundleInfo contains parsed metadata from a Sigstore bundle file.

```go
type BundleInfo struct {
    Method           SigningMethod
    Identity         string // cert SAN — empty for key-based signatures
    Issuer           string // OIDC issuer — empty for key-based signatures
    HasTSATimestamps bool   // true if the bundle contains signed timestamps
}
```

<a name="SignBlobOptions"></a>
## type [SignBlobOptions](<https://github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/blob/main/pkg/signing/cosign.go#L59-L76>)

SignBlobOptions holds the signing configuration for a blob.

```go
type SignBlobOptions struct {
    // Key is the path to a cosign-format private key.
    Key string
    // BundlePath is where the Sigstore bundle is written.
    BundlePath string
    // Password decrypts the private key. PassFunc takes precedence, and
    // COSIGN_PASSWORD is the fallback when neither is set.
    Password string
    // PassFunc resolves the private-key password, taking precedence over Password.
    PassFunc cosign.PassFunc
    // Overwrite allows CheckOverwrite to replace an existing bundle.
    Overwrite bool
    // Timeout bounds the whole operation.
    Timeout time.Duration

    // Deprecated: use Key. Removed in a future version.
    KeyRef string
}
```

## type [SigningMethod](<https://github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/blob/main/pkg/signing/bundle.go#L31>)


<a name="SigningMethodKeyless"></a>

```go
const (
    // SigningMethodKeyless indicates a Fulcio-issued certificate bundle (OIDC/keyless).
    SigningMethodKeyless SigningMethod = "keyless"
    // SigningMethodKey indicates a public-key bundle.
    SigningMethodKey SigningMethod = "key"
)
```
